currentParagraphText: “Naturally, but if you find anything wanting, promptly let me know,” she said with a smile as she walked closer. Jake also couldn’t help but notice how several of the demons around her were higher level, yet it was evident who was in charge of this welcoming party. And damn, did she look like she enjoyed that.
